title: bheka.key.rotated.v1
description: Emitted by eride-vault when a tenant root key is successfully rotated. Consumers must treat replay of this event as audit reconciliation only — never re-execute rotation on replay (010_EVENT_BUS_AND_TOPICS section 5).

event_id.description: UUIDv7. De-duplicate consumers on this field (010_EVENT_BUS_AND_TOPICS section 3).

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC at which the Vault completed the rotation.

tenant_id.description: UUIDv7 of the tenant whose key was rotated.

previous_key_version.description: The key version that was active before rotation. Remains valid for UnwrapDek until shredded.

new_key_version.description: The newly active key version. Agents must use this version's public key for new enrolments.
